steps.heading: How it works

steps.items.title: Play qualifying games
steps.items.text: Open any eligible slot and place a real-money bet of $0.50 or more. Every spin counts automatically.

steps.items.title: Score by multiplier
steps.items.text: Your score is the win multiplier on a qualifying bet — win 25x on a $2 spin and you bank 25 points.

steps.items.title: Climb and collect
steps.items.text: Finish in the top 500 of the daily leaderboard, or catch a random weekly prize drop on any spin.

daily.heading: Daily Tournaments
daily.intro: A fresh leaderboard every 24 hours with more than $20,000 paid out daily. Prizes land as cash — no wagering attached.
daily.scoring: Scoring: your points equal the win multiplier on each qualifying bet. Highest single multiplier wins; ties go to whoever scored first.
drops.heading: Weekly Prize Drops
drops.intro: Any qualifying spin can trigger a random multiplier prize — over $350,000 in drops awarded every week, no leaderboard required.
games.heading: Eligible games
faq.heading: Drops & Wins FAQ

faq.items.q: Do I need to opt in to play?
faq.items.a: No opt-in is required. Place a real-money bet of at least $0.50 on any eligible game and your spins count toward the daily tournament automatically.

faq.items.q: How is my tournament score calculated?
faq.items.a: Your score is the win multiplier on a qualifying bet: win amount divided by stake. A $10 win on a $0.50 spin scores 20 points. Your best single multiplier of the day counts.
Daily tournament prizes are credited within 72 hours of the leaderboard closing. Weekly prize drops are credited instantly when the drop triggers.

faq.items.q: Do tournament prizes carry wagering requirements?
faq.items.a: No. All Drops & Wins prizes are paid as cash with zero wagering requirements and no maximum withdrawal limit.

footer.heading: Play responsibly
footer.note: Tournament play is real-money gambling. Set limits, take breaks, and never chase losses. Players must be 18 or older.
